_citation.caveat: HIGH: 7 anchors — iconographic or terminal case-marker evidence. MEDIUM: 65 anchors — distributional + collocation evidence. LOW: 260 anchors — positional heuristic only, NOT verified phonetic readings. UNCERTAIN: 1 (M267 — high-frequency functional sign, identity unknown). For publication: report only HIGH + MEDIUM anchors as scientifically supportable.

canonical_counts.total_entries: Number of entries in the `anchors` mapping. `total`, `total_all_entries` and `metadata.total_count` all denote this quantity and must always equal it.
canonical_counts.by_confidence: Counts of entries by their `confidence` field; must always sum to total_entries.
canonical_counts.hm_confirmed: HIGH + MEDIUM entries — the set the file's own citation caveat calls 'scientifically supportable' for publication.
canonical_counts.preprint_161: The preprint's '161 anchors' is the H+M count of this file at the time of the Phase-170 grammar-variance retest (after Phase-163's sibilant upgrades raised H+M from 157 to 161); it is preserved as hm_count=161 in reports/phase170_grammar_variance.json and asserted by foundation_check.py CHECK NEW-V. It is a historical snapshot quantity, NOT the current file total.
canonical_counts.corpus_fields: corpus_signs / corpus_tokens / corpus_token_coverage describe the Holdat corpus and token coverage of the H+M set; they are corpus statistics, not file counts, and were not changed by this reconciliation.

_note: total / total_all_entries / metadata.total_count = ALL entries in the anchors mapping (every confidence level). H+M confirmed is reported separately as metadata.hm_confirmed_count. DO NOT use total/corpus_signs for % coverage — use corpus_token_coverage instead. (Corrected 2026-10-05, spec 004 WS3: the previous note claimed total covered H+M only, which contradicted the field's actual value.)
